newsitem.title: USA: Robinson Nugent fiscal Q4 orders up.
newsitem.headline: Robinson Nugent fiscal Q4 orders up.

text.p: Robinson Nugent Inc, whicn makes electronic connectors, integrated circuit sockets and cable assemblies, said Wednesday customer orders for the fiscal fourth quarter rose 13 percent to $20.5 million compared with the year-ago period.
Orders, however, were down six percent from $21.7 million in the third quarter.

Earlier, Robinson Nugent reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended June 30 of $0.18 a share, compared with a loss a year ago of $0.63. Sales for the quarter rose to $22.0 million from $19.2 million.
"Higher revenues coupled with lower manufacturing costs and operating expenses contributed to the improved earnings level," Larry Burke, president, said in a statement.
The fourth quarter included $500,000 in income from a patent infringement settlement and a charge of $250,000 to reduce the carrying value of a facility in Switzerland.

The year-ago fourth quarter included a charge of $2.1 million or $0.40 a share for reduction in the carrying values of production equipment, elimination of goodwill related to a European subsidiary and provisions for workforce reductions.
